skill_name: Ambient Dark Mode Toggle & Glassmorphic Layout

timestamps.description: Light mode interface of the self-hosting website with a navigation bar at the top, a hero section in the middle, and a content section at the bottom, showcasing the design before any modifications.
Dark mode interface of the self-hosting website with a vibrant green glow in the hero section, demonstrating the website's responsiveness to theme changes.
Transition animation of the website, fading from light to dark mode with a color transition, signaling the start of the coding process.
Blank white browser page, representing the initial state of the webpage before any HTML elements are added or styled.
Browser page displaying the initial HTML structure, showing a small black star, an ellipsis, a YouTube link, and placeholder text in a single column, ready for styling.
